My name is not important, but I am a woman of 43 here in Lilongwe with my family. This beans plot is small, only 0.40 hectares, and I intercrop it with maize so the beans can help the soil. I keep most of my fertilizer coupons for the maize plots because maize is what feeds us, so on the beans I rely mostly on the little manure I can gather from the goats and kitchen waste. I use seed I saved from last season because improved bean seed is expensive and not always available at the market here, and I weed carefully with my children rather than buying chemicals.
